name: Windy Toolbox Components
summary: Directory of free Tailwind CSS component collections and kits: buttons, alerts, 404 pages, tables, pricing boxes, skeletons and more.
description: A browsable index of free Tailwind CSS component resources from many creators — Windstatic, HyperUI, 404 Components, Button Components, Table Components, Pricing Box, Skeleton Loading and others — each card linking out to the collection with its author. It sits inside Windy Toolbox, which also hosts templates, kits, generators, guides, plugins and a marketplace.
